subject: Growth handshake + QBR timeblocks for AtlasCorp renewal
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwo od.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@atlascorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlascorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Growth handshake + QBR timeblocks for AtlasCorp renewal

Hi Jared / Priya —

Congrats again on the successful pilot results last quarter. As we head into the renewal window I wanted to kick off a short growth handshake so we can lock the capacity uplift, finalize commercial terms, and book a QBR to align execs and engineering. Proposed next steps below: 

- Quick intake call (30m) to confirm uplift target and critical dates (this week)
- Draft mutual action plan (attached: AtlasCorp_MA-plan_v1.xlsx)
- Legal/SOW draft for your review (attached: SOW-draft-2027-09.pdf)
- QBR: propose two 90-min windows the week of Sept 20th; will slot exec/eng attendees once you confirm

High-level asks for the intake call:
1) Target tokens/day and expected peak throughput after uplift
2) Required data residency / compliance constraints for the new term
3) Any procurement timelines (PO / sign-off deadlines)

If you can confirm who on your side will own procurement (email alias is fine) and a couple of preferred windows for the QBR, I’ll circulate a calendar hold and route the right Redwood people (solutions engineer + renewals lead).

Thanks — looking forward to working through this with you.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: AtlasCorp_MA-plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-draft-2027-09.pdf (PDF)

From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@atlascorp.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlascorp.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Growth handshake + QBR timeblocks for AtlasCorp renewal

Thanks Lukas — appreciate the clear plan.

Quick answers:
- Procurement: procurement@atlascorp.com (I'll loop them in after we confirm costs)
- Uplift target: canonical goal is +3x token throughput from current baseline, with staged ramp over 60 days
- Data residency: US-only for now, no additional constraints beyond SOC2 attestations (we have your evidence)

QBR window: we prefer Sept 22 (afternoon PT) or Sept 24 (morning PT). Either works; Sept 22 is slightly better for our execs.

I’ll add Priya to lead the internal procurement coordination. Can you confirm what the uplift delta looks like from a cost and headroom standpoint (ballpark) so I can route a pre-read to procurement?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Growth handshake + QBR timeblocks for AtlasCorp renewal

Lukas — quick internal note before we lock anything externally.

- If they’re doing a staged +3x over 60 days we should prepare a staggered commit (3 phases) and include a short burst buffer for seasonal peaks. I recommend we propose: Phase 1 (baseline +50%), Phase 2 (+150%), Phase 3 (+200% relative to baseline) with autoscale headroom between phases.
- Solutions engineer should run a short demo in the QBR focused on response-time and caching improvements; cc Ben for SE availability.
- From pricing: Neha can draft a 2-option commercial: (A) committed capacity (discounted) + burst overlay, (B) pay-as-you-go with higher unit cost but no long-term commit. We should present both in the QBR so procurement has options.

I’ll take the lead on the commercial options and draft a slide for the QBR pre-read. Lukas — once you confirm the final QBR slot, I’ll prepare the pre-read and a short runbook for the ops team.

Marissa
Sr. Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@atlascorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@atlascorp.com>, procurement@atlascorp.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Growth handshake + QBR timeblocks for AtlasCorp renewal

Thanks Jared — Sept 22 works for us. Locking the QBR:

QBR details (confirmed)
- Date: Wed, Sept 22, 2027
- Time: 2:30–4:00 PM PT (90 minutes)
- Format: 20m exec readout, 40m technical demo + runbook, 30m commercial & procurement options
- Attendees (tentative): Jared Cole (AtlasCorp), Priya Singh (AtlasCorp), procurement@atlascorp.com, + Redwood: Lukas Meyer, Marissa Cole, Neha Kapoor, Ben Carter (SE)

Immediate next steps:
1) Lukas: schedule calendar invite and attach the MA-plan + SOW draft (will send in 15m)
2) Marissa/Neha: finalize the two commercial options and a one-page pre-read (due by Sept 15)
3) Ben: confirm SE availability for Sept 22 and provide a 20-minute demo script (by Sept 10)
4) AtlasCorp: share expected peak tokens/day by Sept 8 so we can validate headroom planning

Ballpark uplift delta (per your ask)
- If they move to the committed three-phase plan: estimated monthly spend delta ~ +$18k–$32k depending on phase cadence and burst usage. I’ll include a conservative and a mid-case in the pre-read.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/ATC-2027-42
Pre-read folder (will populate): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0B-Atlas-QBR-2027

If procurement wants us to route a formal SOW revision to their contract team in advance, please confirm and we’ll CC legal on the next thread.

Thanks everyone — I’ll send the calendar hold now.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com
